title: ALLAH NIGEHBAAN WATAN JAATI HU'N BHAI
body:
Ab aakhri mujra Main baja laati hu'n Bhai
Ujde huwe kunbe ko liye jaati hu'nBhai
Maalum nahi laut ke kab aati hu'nBhai
<<MINI>>
Dil doob raha hai Mera ghabraati hu'nBhai
Allah nigehbaan watan jaati hu'nBhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Haidar ka Pisar Fatima ki jaan yahin hai
Wo jis pa wafa hogayi qurbaan yahin hai
Bhayya Mere parde ka nigehbaan yahin hai
<<MINI>>
Dil doob raha hai Mera ghabraati hu'nBhai
Allah nigehbaan watan jaati hu'nBhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Lakhte Dil e Shabbir ko kaleje se lagana
Be chain jo Asghar ho to seene pa sulaana
Bhayya Mere bachchon ko kahin bhool na jaana
<<MINI>>
Dil doob raha hai Mera ghabraati hu'nBhai
Allah nigehbaan watan jaati hu'nBhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab kaaheko phir laut ke yaad aaegi Zainab
Ab tum ko Madine me kahan paaegi Zainab
Marjayegi marjayegi marjayegi Zainab
<<MINI>>
Dil doob raha hai Mera ghabraati hu'nBhai
Allah nigehbaan watan jaati hu'nBhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Batlaao ke kab tak yuni khamosh rahoge
Kya khwahar e Nashaad ko rukhsat na karoge
Sughra ke liye kya koi paiGham na doge
<<MINI>>
Dil doob raha hai Mera ghabraati hu'nBhai
Allah nigehbaan watan jaati hu'nBhai
<<DIVIDER>>
Khamosh Saeed ab ke nahi zabt ka yaara
Sab ahle haram rote the ek hashr bapa tha
Tha turbat e Shabbir pa Zainab ka ye Nouha
<<MINI>>
Dil doob raha hai Mera ghabraati hu'nBhai
Allah nigehbaan watan jaati hu'n Bhai
author: Saeed Shaheedi
